decisions.reason: Requiring full breakout access does not change any existing GPIO assignment or the compatibility policy.
The source retains the ESP32-S3 platform and does not change the selected module model or part number.
Buttons are mentioned only as an example of future platform reuse; the current panel-control connector inventory and placement policy remain unchanged.
The full-pin breakout decision does not alter the BOOT or reset controls, capacitances, or timing network.
Full ESP32-S3 pin access does not change the I2C pull-ups, series resistors, topology, speed, or cable assumptions.
The source concerns a main-board ESP32 breakout and does not modify the separate sensor-board connector fanout.
The breakout and platform-reuse decision does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, compensation, or rail role.
Reusing the board as a generic ESP32-S3 platform does not itself change the existing USB data lines or programming-port role.
The source does not change standalone USB power behavior, regulator selection, source OR-ing, or powered loads.
The ESP32 breakout decision has no entailed effect on the battery-charge display or external charge-LED interface.
The source does not affect the battery NTC connector, function, or thermal-protection controller.
Full pin access does not change the established GPIO5 boost-enable assignment or any 5V boost-rail behavior.
